purpose: Freeze case dispositions and hash inputs before any official isolated P10 runs; this packet does not authorize runs or confer P10/VIP qualification.

corrected_provenance.release_manifest_source_revision_relatio: release_manifest.git_commit and git_tree identify the pre-manifest inventory source revision; the sidecar records the manifest commit and verifies that its parent/tree match those fields
corrected_provenance.release_manifest_self_reference_policy: release_manifest.json and its sidecar are excluded from the inventory hash set to avoid recursive self-reference; the sidecar still locks the current manifest bytes
corrected_provenance.archive_verification_method: compare the extracted project archive to git archive of the recorded commit and tree

juice.access_log_disclosure.v1.basis: Target-local implementation and rerun passed, but the currently independent oracle decision explicitly accepts only three predicates and lists access-log among binding non-approvals.
juice.access_log_disclosure.v1.required_next_action: Independent governance reviewer must confirm the redacted log-resource predicate before inclusion in the official scoring set.

juice.directory_listing.v1.basis: Runtime did not satisfy the directory-index causal predicate; candidate and independent control failed the predicate.
juice.directory_listing.v1.reopen_condition: Authorized target-local runtime/configuration review must establish the predicate without bypassing controls or modifying Generic Core.

juice.forgotten_backup.v1.basis: Candidate and independent control returned 403; anonymous-read precondition and causal delta were not demonstrated.
juice.forgotten_backup.v1.reopen_condition: Authorized target-local configuration review must establish a safe read-only precondition without retaining raw backup content.

juice.misplaced_signature_file.v1.basis: Mapped resource is absent from the checked-out source and runtime candidate/control did not establish the signature exposure predicate.
juice.misplaced_signature_file.v1.reopen_condition: Version-matched source/runtime mapping must be independently established without retaining raw YAML.

juice.privacy_policy_proof.v1.basis: Challenge-completion/read-policy behavior is not a vulnerability causal predicate.

juice.public_scoreboard_route.v1.basis: Route reachability or hidden-page discovery does not establish a security weakness.

juice.security_policy.v1.basis: Public security-policy resource availability is not a vulnerability oracle.

juice.well_known_security_policy.v1.basis: Alternate policy-resource location duplicates policy semantics and is not an independent vulnerability case.

final_approved_scoring_case_set.reason: These are the only predicates explicitly accepted by the prior oracle decision; this corrected packet requires a human independent reviewer to reconfirm them against the current source hash.

drift_reconciliation.synthetic_unit_test_scope: tests/test_p10_benchmark.py uses a separate 10-case fixture with 3 oracle-approved cases; its 7 is not the Juice Shop production count.

hash_lock.hash_interpretation: Canonical mapping/oracle values are prior review locks. Current source mapping/oracle hashes identify the source presently awaiting human reconfirmation. Document, snapshot, source-to-ground-truth manifest, and runtime manifest hashes identify exact local inputs. Release manifest provenance is verified by the non-recursive sidecar. The frozen ground truth was not modified to hide drift.

required_before_authorization: Independent governance reviewer signs this exact packet and reviewed hashes.
The approved case set is explicitly frozen with no pending dispositions.
Each approved case has an accepted semantic causal predicate and safe precondition.
Each approved case has baseline, candidate, independent negative control, central verification, sealed ProofBundle, verify_seal, and replay evidence contracts.
Three isolated runs are executed only after the minimum approved-set and class gates are met.
